mechanism: Multiplicity-averaged sampled gradients; replace particle Adam diagonal moment by one isotropic scalar second moment per row. Update each row moments and their bias-correction clock only when its gradient is nonzero, including direct auxiliary gradients. Scale by inverse sqrt of beta2-EMA active-row fraction to retain dense-clock sparse-Adam conditional energy. Inactive rows do not move. Original betas/epsilon/LR schedule; no clipping.
rationale: Shared covariance preserved rare mass (eigen .629) but still collapsed ring to six. Test independent row mobility with direction-preserving isotropic normalization, separating a row visit clock from the global iteration clock; do not distort each row direction coordinate by coordinate.
optimizer_updates: One D plus one G/particle update per frozen iteration; particle custom update substitutes original Adam table update.
extra_work: Multiplicity bincount/rescaling, O(N*d) row reductions, CUDA per-row moment/visit updates and bias corrections. No extra forward/backward/update calls; equal-step only.
